components.name: Metal Frame (aluminum)

components.name: Junction Box

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA)

components.name: Backsheet

components.name: Epoxy Adhesive (for cell to backsheet bonding)
components.reasoning: Specialty adhesive ensuring a strong and watertight bond between the solar cells and backsheet, essential for module durability but typically integrated into larger assembly processes.

components.name: Silicon Backsheet (typically polyester with EVA or POE coating)
components.reasoning: Rear protective layer integrating various materials to enhance protection and performance characteristics compared to a simple glass-glass setup.

components.name: Mounting Hardware (clamps, bolts, brackets)
components.reasoning: Hardware used in module installation processes that can be procurement items but might vary based on specific application requirements or design decisions.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Monocrystalline silicon modules represent approximately 85% of global solar panel production as of 2024 due to higher efficiency (20-22%) and declining manufacturing costs, making them the dominant commercial and residential standard.

components.name: Solar Cells (Monocrystalline Silicon)
components.reasoning: These cells are essential for converting sunlight into electrical power and are the core component of PV modules, making up the majority of their weight and volume.

components.name: Glass Cover (Tempered or Reinforced)
components.reasoning: This protective layer shields solar cells from environmental factors while allowing maximum light transmission and maintaining module integrity over time.

components.name: Backsheet Material
components.reasoning: The backsheet provides a moisture barrier, insulation against electrical leakage, and mechanical protection to the solar cell layers behind it.

components.name: Aluminum Frame/Standards (Front and Rear)
components.reasoning: The frame ensures structural integrity of the module while serving as an anchoring point for installation or mounting systems; often included in separate supply chains.

components.name: Junction Box (Electrical Connections & Protection)
components.reasoning: This assembly contains circuit breakers, fuses, and connectors required to safely manage electrical current flow and protect against short circuits.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (Ethylene Vinyl Acetate or EVA Film)
components.reasoning: EVA encapsulates the solar cells and backsheet to isolate them from moisture while maintaining an optimal space for light transmission and cooling.

components.name: Insulating Spacers (Between Glass Cover & Backsheet)
components.reasoning: These small components maintain air gaps between layers, often made of plastic or silicone and essential for heat dissipation and protection against debris intrusion.

components.name: Connector Strips (Front Busbars)
components.reasoning: These ensure the effective transfer of electrical current from cells to internal wires, a critical yet somewhat integrated part in module assembly processes.
